content: Keratosis follicularis-dwarfism-cerebral atrophy syndrome is a rare, presumably X-linked recessive[2] genetic disorder characterized by keratosis follicularis, severe congenital proportionate dwarfism, and brain atrophy.[3] Other less common findings include microcephaly, intellectual disability, alopecia, epilepsy, and inguinal hernias.[4] It has only been described in 6 males from a 2-generation Mexican family.[5][6]
